SKILL_SOURCE:
git clone https://github.com/BlackVS/aiskills.git and read
aiskills/skills/oh-code-review/SKILL.md.
CLONE_AND_FETCH:
git clone https://gitea.example.com/{repo}.git (credentials are
preconfigured), git fetch origin refs/pull/{num}/head and diff it against
the PR base branch.
POST_COMMAND:
tea comment --repo {repo} {num} "$(cat review.md)" (tea is installed and
logged in).
